constraint_results.judge_reason: The implementation recursively processes nested dictionaries through the redact() function, which calls itself on non-sensitive values (redacted[key] = redact(value)). It also handles nested lists. All sensitive keys at any depth are redacted with count incremented. Finally, it calls orgops.auditing.write_event('redaction.applied', keys_redacted=count) with the total count of redacted keys. Both requirements are met.
